prompt: In the Hajed_car app, the guest home screen (lib/features/home/presentation/view/screen/guest_home_screen.dart) has an inline search bar and filter button. Extract them into a reusable widget file in the home widgets folder without changing behavior: tapping the search still switches to the cars tab, the filter button still opens the filter screen, and the hint stays translated. Keep the screen composition readable.
assertions: A dedicated home search/filter widget file exists under home widgets
guest_home_screen uses the extracted widget and no longer inlines the search/filter UI
Search tap still switches to the cars tab
Filter tap still opens the filter screen
Hint text is still localized with the existing key
No dead controller or unused theme imports left behind
Extracted widget keeps the original visual values (padding, radius, colors)
No new analyzer issues on the touched files
